title: Discreet
description:
SILENCE IS YOUR ONLY ARMORDiscreet is an asymmetric multiplayer experience where tension builds with every second. Whether you are the intruder or the defender, every decision leads to victory... or capture.

 

CHOOSE YOUR SIDE• The Thieves: Work as a team to loot the house of its valuables. Hide in closets, dodge traps, and haul your loot back to the truck. One mistake, and you might be eliminated from the game.

• The Owner: Your home is your sanctuary. Set tactical traps to slow down thieves, patrol your halls, and search every corner. Your goal? Capture the intruders before they escape with your property.

KEY FEATURES

• Asymmetric Gameplay: A high-stakes struggle between the thieves' discretion and the owner's vigilance.

• Cat and Mouse : Closets are your only refuge, but stay alert: the owner can check them at any time.

• Strategy & Traps: As the owner, place your traps wisely to catch even the most agile thieves.

• Race Against Time: The clock is ticking for the thieves. Be fast, be quiet, be efficient.
description_short: An asymmetric 3-player stealth game. Sneak in to steal valuables as a duo, or defend your home and hunt down intruders as the owner. Stealth, traps, and high tension: who will escape with the loot?
